Messages.Author: Charles_Bronson
Messages.Body:
I have only 1 pool left.
I call a referendum to become a prince.
My predator controls lutz, and he is ready.

Can I throw voter captivation before dying from lutz special?
and why?

thanks

I am death.
Paul Kersey, Death Wish

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Lutz' special applies after the referendum resolves.
So do Voter Captivation.
So the first think that happens is that your vampire becomes Prince.
Then you can choose to gain the pool first, before applying Lutz' special.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
